scope: Close f.4a reset, malformed-default, callback-lifetime and following-record readiness checks; no emitter/graph qualification
cases: A generated in-memory OBJECTS section delivers one complete DICTIONARYWDFLT and then a DICTIONARYVAR sentinel; both typed callbacks and the sentinel value are checked.
DICTIONARYWDFLT code-340 presence survives adapter storage, copy construction and copy assignment.
Reset clears the target object's default handle/completeness evidence without changing a previously parsed copy.
Missing and duplicate code-340 controls fail the read and deliver no DICTIONARYWDFLT callback.
The other eight named-object callback values are checked after the callback source objects leave scope; null MLEADERSTYLE is ignored without an extra row.
